What is SlidesAI?

Lightweight Google Slides and PowerPoint add-on that converts pasted text or a topic into a structured slide deck. Deliberately narrow in scope - it does text-to-slides and little else, at a low price.

Best for

Fast, cheap text-to-slides inside Google Slides.

Main features

  • Paste text and generate a structured deck
  • generate from a topic prompt
  • choose presentation type (general, educational, sales, conference)
  • automatic slide count and structure
  • colour and font presets
  • supports 100+ languages
  • works directly inside Google Slides
  • basic image suggestions
  • magic write for individual slides.

Practical use cases

  • Turning lecture notes into a teaching deck
  • converting a report's executive summary into slides
  • quickly producing a deck for a class assignment
  • generating a starting structure to then edit manually.

Who is it for?

  • Students, teachers, small business owners and individuals who occasionally need a quick deck.

Pricing, free access & limits

Freemium subscription with monthly presentation credits

Plans described in the source

Free with roughly 3 presentations per month and a character limit per presentation (historically around 2,500 characters). Basic around $10/mo ($8 annually) with roughly 10 presentations/month and higher character limits. Pro around $20/mo ($16 annually) with roughly 30 presentations/month, larger inputs and priority. Premium/Enterprise tiers for higher volume. Annual billing roughly 20% cheaper.

Free plan

Yes - free tier with roughly 3 presentations per month.

Free trial

Free tier serves as the trial.

Usage limits to consider

Metered by presentations generated per month plus a character limit per input. Free tier is very restrictive at roughly 3 presentations and a small character cap.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • Cheapest option in this group and genuinely simple - there is almost nothing to learn
  • native Google Slides output means fully editable results
  • broad language support at 100+ is unusual for a tool at this price
  • no separate platform to adopt.

Limitations to consider

  • Very limited compared with Gamma or Plus AI - it produces basic structure and little design value
  • image handling is weak
  • no brand kit, template respect or collaboration features
  • character limits force splitting long content
  • output almost always needs substantial manual design work
  • minimal support.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Google Slides add-on, PowerPoint add-in

Languages

  • 100+ languages supported for input and output including Arabic and French

API access

No public API

Integrations and exports

  • Google Slides, Google Workspace, PowerPoint
  • no data or dashboard integrations

Evaluation notes

Treat SlidesAI as a structure generator, not a design tool - it saves the outlining step and nothing more. For anything client-facing, Plus AI or Gamma will require far less rework.
